changes.summary: Bound this recipe to the evidence-backed model capability authority without changing runtime behavior.

changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: The host allowlist now matches the pinned Step1X runtime distribution while preserving offline execution after installation.
changes.summary: Added the Ubuntu security mirror required by the shared Step1X package-install build.

changes.details: Operator guidance names the exact next recipe and the existing 240 MiB downstream input limit without claiming unsupported composite orchestration.

Declared exact one-image input and single-GLB output slots with bounded bytes.
Made the controlled label-geometry Candidate installable with a bounded signed image-to-GLB entrypoint while retaining physical Spark qualification as pending.
Pinned official Step1X source cb5ac944, PyTorch 2.13, CUDA 13.2, and SM121-native build authority.
Eliminated the implicit BRIA download, bound DINOv2 and CLIP processor authorities, and fixed the official symmetry and edge contract.
Marked the label-geometry binding non-executable pending Step1X source, label handling, native dependencies, and a GLB adapter.
Added the authoritative isolated image input contract.
